narrator.instruct: Gripping, energetic sports-history storyteller. Excited and punchy, vivid emphasis on the surprising turns, a hint of amused disbelief. No long pauses.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: This Olympic runner took a car.

voice.instruct: Dramatic, excited opening hook, punchy, amazed, hitting 'took a car' hard.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In the nineteen-oh-four St. Louis marathon, Fred Lorz stopped on a hot, dusty road and got a ride.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: When the car broke down, he ran the final stretch and crossed the finish line first.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The crowd thought he had won.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But officials learned about the ride and disqualified him.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The real winner, Thomas Hicks, was so exhausted he could barely stand.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The man who crossed first wasn't the winner.
